description:
Get all target-disease associations for a specific disease and save to parquet file.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table association_overall_direct — one record = one direct target-disease association score over all evidence.
Key: diseaseId, targetId.
Arguments: disease_id accepts ot disease or disease name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by score desc (upstream sorts every match); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.target` counts targets; `_vbt.grains.disease` counts diseases.
Rows with unknown score are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Direct OT 25.09 associations (evidence on the disease itself); absence means no evidence, not a negative finding.

disease_id.description: Accepts ot_disease, disease_name; resolved to one ot_disease (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

min_score.description: Keeps rows with score >= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0.0; pass 0 for no restriction (null is not accepted).
